standard: 音译专名统一 + 自然意译；一句一译；键取自对齐原串（Think 1 11-18/11-19 已验收译文）

entries.en: What do you do in your free time?
entries.zh: 你空闲的时候做什么？

entries.en: OK, we know you all like watching TV and playing computer games, but we want to know some of the other things you do when you've got some free time.
entries.zh: 好，我们知道你们都喜欢看电视和玩电脑游戏，但我们想知道你们有空时还会做些什么别的事。

entries.en: Right, and let us know.
entries.zh: 那么，请告诉我们吧。

entries.en: Hermione.
entries.zh: 赫敏。

entries.en: I love cats!
entries.zh: 我超喜欢猫！

entries.en: I like watching cat videos on YouTube every day.
entries.zh: 我喜欢每天在 YouTube 上看猫的视频。

entries.en: I love taking photos of them, too, cats that I see when I'm outside - I try to get photos of lots of different kinds.
entries.zh: 我也喜欢给它们拍照，也就是我在外面看到的猫——我尽量拍下很多不同品种的猫。

entries.en: And I collect things with cats on them - you know, cards or notebooks or T-shirts, things like that.
entries.zh: 而且我收集上面有猫的东西——你知道的，卡片、笔记本或者 T 恤之类的。

entries.en: But we can't have cats at home because my dad can't stand them!
entries.zh: 但我们家不能养猫，因为我爸爸受不了它们！

entries.en: Andy.
entries.zh: 安迪。

entries.en: I can't stand having nothing to do - for example, when I wait for the bus or in the queue at the fast food place - so I always have my puzzle app on my mobile.
entries.zh: 我受不了没事可做——比如等公交车或者在快餐店排队的时候——所以我的手机里总是装着智力游戏应用。

entries.en: Sometimes it's Sudoku, sometimes a crossword or different word game, but it doesn't matter - I just love doing puzzles.
entries.zh: 有时是数独，有时是填字游戏或其他文字游戏，但都无所谓——我就是喜欢玩智力游戏。

entries.en: And it's great because I never get bored.
entries.zh: 这很棒，因为我从不觉得无聊。

entries.en: Natalie.
entries.zh: 娜塔莉。

entries.en: I'm usually busy, but occasionally I've got a bit of free time, especially in the evening after I do my homework.
entries.zh: 我通常很忙，但偶尔会有一点空闲时间，尤其是在晚上做完作业以后。

entries.en: My favourite thing is looking at maps online.
entries.zh: 我最喜欢做的事是在网上看地图。

entries.en: I like using 'street view' and I imagine myself walking in a street somewhere.
entries.zh: 我喜欢用“街景”，想象自己走在某条街上。

entries.en: My dream is to go to New York, so I often 'walk' in the streets there.
entries.zh: 我的梦想是去纽约，所以我经常在那里的街上“走走”。

entries.en: I try and visit a different place in the world at least once a week.
entries.zh: 我尽量每周至少游览世界上一个不同的地方。

entries.en: Lucy.
entries.zh: 露西。

entries.en: I don't really like sport - I hate running and doing exercise and all that - but I'm crazy about the New Zealand rugby team, the All Blacks.
entries.zh: 我不太喜欢运动——讨厌跑步、锻炼那一类的事——但我特别喜欢新西兰橄榄球队全黑队。

entries.en: It's because my uncle and aunt live there and they love rugby, so I watch the games and collect anything I can about them!
entries.zh: 因为我叔叔和阿姨住在那里，他们热爱橄榄球，所以我看比赛，还尽我所能收集关于他们的一切！

entries.en: I have a book that I put photos and newspaper articles in.
entries.zh: 我有一个本子，用来放照片和报纸上的文章。

entries.en: Once a week my uncle and I talk on the internet about the All Blacks - I love that!
entries.zh: 每周我都会和叔叔在网上聊全黑队——我太喜欢这样了！
